title: Design System: 最強獵人 (The Strongest Hunter)

display.purpose: The 最強獵人 wordmark on the home band only; 64px at ≥768px.

headline.purpose: Page titles; 24px on equipment detail, 28px on skill detail, 20px on the build page.

title.purpose: Section headings (裝備, 技能, 資料庫); on detail pages and pickers set on a 2px ink rule.

item-title.purpose: Equipment, slot and skill names in rows; 17px on index rows, 15px in selectors.

body.purpose: Descriptions and level effects, 60 to 65ch; palt off.

label.purpose: Field labels above values, meta lines (12 to 13px, ink-2), nav labels.

button.purpose: Solid and outline buttons; the phone share dock uses 16px, the desktop header 14px.

numeral-spec.purpose: Big values on spec strips (攻擊力, 防禦力, 漂流石槽).

numeral.purpose: Ledger values and auto-build plan percentages; /max follows at 15px/600 ink-2.

numeral-inline.purpose: Counts inside 13px CJK status lines and Lv tags (14px).

brand-wordmark.purpose: 最強獵人 in the 56px shell band.

brand-mark.purpose: MHN in a 1.5px shell-ink-2 frame, 22px tall, 2px radius; the only uppercase tracked Latin.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheet and centred dialog panel (daylight), over a 60% dark scrim.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Toast and the saved-build plate lifted off the home band (daylight).

shadows.name: spent-edge
shadows.purpose: Outline of a spent overflow cell; an edge, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Movement: temper heat, sheet rise, toast, ledger enter/leave.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Colour transitions on rows, buttons, tabs (Tailwind default).

motion.name: duration-row
motion.purpose: Row and tile hover fills and border shifts.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Buttons, tabs, inputs, chevron rotation, switch thumb.

motion.name: duration-toast
motion.purpose: Toast rise (10px) and sheet scrim fade.

motion.name: duration-ledger
motion.purpose: Ledger rows entering/leaving (8px slide + fade) and moving.

motion.name: duration-temper
motion.purpose: A newly lit temper cell heating from forge orange through t1 (35%) to its resting oxide colour.

motion.name: temper-keyframes
motion.value: @keyframes temper { 0% { background-color: var(--forge); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--forge); } 35% { background-color: var(--t1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px transparent; } 100% { background-color: var(--cell-colour); } }
motion.purpose: Runs only on change or on a newly arrived skill, never on first paint.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: Design target 375 to 428px; 16px gutter, full-bleed lists, bottom tab bar, share dock.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Weapon-type list 2 columns; skill chip grids 3 columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Tabs move into the shell band; sheets centre (max 576px, 82dvh); lists box with 1px rule + 4px radius; 24px gutter.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Build page splits into gear + 432px sticky ledger (top 72px); share moves into the gear header.

breakpoints.name: container-wide
breakpoints.note: Shell band and build page max width.

breakpoints.name: container-read
breakpoints.note: Browse and detail pages max width.

components.description: Phone navigation: five equal 60px tabs on blued steel; the active tab fills shell-raised with a 3px top bar. Weapon and armor tabs use the official glyphs.

narrative.overview:
The build is forged work on the smithy bench. The page is a sheet of cold-rolled steel by day and soot-blued steel by night; a deep blued-steel band carries the brand and navigation like the tang of a blade, stamped with a maker's mark. Every skill level is drawn as a heat-temper oxide band, straw through bronze, peacock and purple to blue, so a maxed skill reads as a fully tempered bar and levels past the cap spill beyond a visible stop as spent, overheated grey. When gear changes, the affected cells re-heat from forge orange back to their resting oxide colour. That one moment is the system's signature.

The interface is dense and plain on purpose: a phone in one hand, outdoors, between hunts. Lists are divided by hairline steel rules rather than floated cards; numbers are set as condensed punch-stamped figures that can be read at a glance; CJK is a workhorse Hei that carries hierarchy through weight. Colour is rationed. The temper scale is the only data palette, forge orange marks the single primary action on a screen, and blued-steel navy carries everything else that must look solid or selected. Official game imagery (equipment art, weapon-type and armor-part glyphs, the skill icon) is the content colour on the page and sits on machined steel plates.

It must not read as the old parchment, gold and Cinzel look, as a generic SaaS dashboard, as a flashy hard-to-read game skin, or as a knock-off of the in-game MHN interface.
keyCharacteristics: Steel ground, steel panel, recessed steel inset: depth by tone and 1px rules, not by shadow.
A blued-steel shell band (header, bottom tab bar, sheet title bars) carries brand, navigation and selection.
Skill levels as temper bars: one cell per level, oxide colour by position, a visible max stop, a spent hatch for overflow.
Condensed stamped numerals (Saira Condensed, tabular) beside a Hei CJK workhorse (Noto Sans TC).
One forge-orange action per screen; everything else solid is shell navy.
Machined corners of 1 to 6px; dashed borders mean empty or add.
Daylight is the default; dark is "forge at night".

rules.name: The Temper-Only-Data Rule
rules.body: t1 to t5 appear only where they encode a skill level: temper cells and the legend that explains them. Never on borders, icons, badges, backgrounds, hovers, or charts of any other quantity.

rules.name: The One Forge Rule
rules.body: One forge-orange control per screen, and it is the primary action. Every other solid action is shell navy; forge otherwise appears only as heat (caret, temper flash).

rules.name: The Blued Selection Rule
rules.body: Selected, filled, locked and on states are shown by filling with shell navy and switching to shell ink, never by tinting with an accent colour.

rules.name: The Stamped Figure Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that is data (levels, counts, stats, Lv tags, n/max fractions) is set in Saira Condensed with tabular lining figures, one weight step heavier than the CJK beside it. CJK is never set in Saira.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: UI text lives between 12 and 17px and takes its hierarchy from weight (900, 700, 500, 400) and ink step; only the home wordmark exceeds 30px. Uppercase tracked Latin is reserved for the MHN maker's mark.

rules.name: The Fixed Column Rule
rules.body: The skill ledger is a fixed grid (name, temper bar at least 6.5rem, Lv/max 3.25rem, chevron 1rem, 10px gaps) in catalogue order. Swapping gear changes values in place; rows never reshuffle.

rules.name: The Thumb Dock Rule
rules.body: Below 1024px the primary action docks full-width at the bottom, directly above the tab bar, where the thumb already is.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Anything resting on the page is flat and separated by rules and tone. A shadow means the thing has been lifted: a sheet, a toast, or the saved build on the home band.

rules.name: The Machined Corner Rule
rules.body: Corners stay between 1 and 6px; 3px on controls, 4px on containers.

rules.name: The Dashed-Is-Empty Rule
rules.body: A dashed border always means "nothing here yet, tap to fill"; it is never decoration.

dos: Do draw every skill level as temper cells: one cell per level, as many cells as the skill's max, coloured by `ceil(i / max × 5)` along t1 to t5, a 2px max stop after the last cell, and overflow as spent-hatch cells past the stop.
Do give forge orange to exactly one control per screen, the primary action (複製分享連結 on the build page, 開始配裝 on home), and make every other solid action shell navy.

Do set data numerals in Saira Condensed (`.stamp`, tabular lining figures) one weight heavier than the CJK beside them: 15px/700 inline, 22px/800 in the ledger and plan tiles, 30px/800 on spec strips.
Do show selected, filled, locked and on states by filling with shell navy and switching to shell ink.
Do set equipment art on the steel plate (inset, 1px rule, 4px radius) and tint official weapon-type and armor-part glyphs with currentColor.
Do mark empty slots, empty sockets, add actions and empty states with a 1px dashed rule-strong border.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px, primary actions 48px, and the phone gutter 16px.
Do heat temper cells only when a level changes or a skill first arrives (640ms, 45ms stagger, ease-out-quint), and make it instant under reduced motion.
Do design for daylight first and give every new colour token both a daylight and a night value.
donts: Don't use t1 to t5 anywhere except to encode a skill level: no temper-coloured borders, icons, badges, backgrounds, or charts of other quantities.
Don't add a second forge-orange control, or use forge for links, hovers, selection or decoration.
Don't drift back to the old parchment, gold and Cinzel look: no warm paper grounds, gold accents or fantasy serif.
Don't let it read as a generic SaaS dashboard: no floating cards with resting shadows, no gradient buttons, no cards inside cards.

Don't let it become a flashy game skin or a knock-off of the in-game MHN UI: no glows, metallic or decorative gradients, textured or ornamented frames, or copied in-game panel chrome. The spent hatch is the only gradient.
Don't put a shadow on anything resting on the page; shadows belong to the sheet, the toast and the saved-build plate on the home band.
Don't round corners beyond 6px or use pills.
Don't use the stone colours outside the driftstone swatch, or let them stand in for temper, rarity or element.
Don't set CJK in Saira Condensed or letterspace CJK body text; uppercase tracked Latin belongs only to the MHN maker's mark.
Don't reorder ledger rows when gear changes; values update in place in catalogue order.
